intended_object: For a diagram D : J ⥤ TopCat, a stage j and a compact open U ⊆ D(j), the cylinder open π_j⁻¹(U) in the (chosen) limit of D. These are the standard basic opens of an inverse limit of spectral spaces. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: The body `(Opens.map (limit.π D k.1)).obj k.2.1` is exactly the preimage of the compact open `k.2.1` under the limit projection `limit.π D k.1`. The index type `compactOpenCylinderIndex D` is a Σ-type of a stage j together with a compact open of D(j). The definition is definitionally `compactOpenCylinder D (limit.cone D)`, and the library uses it to show that these cylinders form a basis of the chosen limit when the stages are spectral spaces and the transition maps are spectral maps. The `[HasLimit D]` assumption is harmless, since limits always exist in TopCat.{max v u}. The section variable `[IsCofiltered J]` is probably carried along even though the preimage construction needs no cofilteredness, but the notion is only used for, and only standard for, cofiltered limits, so this is cosmetic. Mathlib has the underlying basis theorem `TopCat.isTopologicalBasis_cofiltered_limit` but no named cylinder family, so no Mathlib counterpart is given. The definition is a faithful formalization of compact-open cylinder sets.
